name: Demo project
_comment: A complete, generic project definition: roles, the allocation plan the
operator hands to the scheduler, and which registered builder plays which
role. Nothing here is specific to a board or a vendor; replace the role
keys, rule matches and script commands with your own.
Project tree on the host (mounted at /work):
Apply with: node scripts/platformctl.mjs apply projects/demo/project.json

roles.name: UI developer
roles.description: Edits the UI subtree of the project
roles.operation_prompt: Only modify files under the ui/ directory. Sync the work tree first; when done, run the repository's smoke script and describe in your result which UI behaviors changed.

roles.name: Driver developer
roles.description: Edits the driver subtree of the project
roles.operation_prompt: Only modify files under the drivers/ directory; do not touch ui/. When done, confirm that it compiles with no obvious memory errors, and describe the changes in your result.

roles.name: Code review
roles.description: Applies and reviews change packages, commits the canonical tree
roles.operation_prompt: Apply the change packages submitted by the upstream development roles to the main repository, and check for out-of-scope edits or obvious errors; commit once verified, and write the conclusion in your result.

roles.name: Board test
roles.description: Runs the project test entry point on the attached board
roles.operation_prompt: Run the project's test entry point on the attached board and collect serial logs and artifacts; on failure, extract the key log lines instead of only reporting the failure.

plan.name: demo-allocation
_text_comment: text is the natural-language description written for operators; it describes the same allocation as the rules below.
rules take precedence in the manifest; edit this text in the admin console and save, and the scheduler recompiles it from the new description.
plan.text:
Route UI-related requests (category ui, or descriptions mentioning interface, frontend, or page) to ui-dev: first run bash /scripts/sync-worktree.sh to sync the work tree, then run bash /scripts/collect-changes.sh to collect changes when done, with a 30-minute timeout. Afterwards, code-review runs bash /scripts/apply-changes.sh to merge into the main repository, then test-bench runs bash /scripts/run-tests.sh for on-board tests on the attached board.
Route driver-related requests (category driver, or descriptions mentioning driver or kernel) to driver-dev, with the same flow as UI and a 60-minute timeout.
Route requests without a clear category to ui-dev, then have code-review review and merge them without on-board tests; when unsure, do not assign requests to other roles.

build.instruction: Fix the reported UI problem in this project.
Fix the reported driver problem in this project.
Complete the requested change in this project.
